incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD:INCIDENT12345 service=runtime-router region=us-west metric=router_p95_latency value=1200ms threshold=1000ms

pagerduty-bot: Triggered on policy 'router-latency-p95' (escalation policy: oncall-rotation). Paging primary oncall.

Maya: ack'd (oncall). I'm looking at the dashboards, seeing a sudden p95 spike across 3 hosts.

Sanjay: also seeing a correlated spike in proxy cpu and GPU host prefill queue. timeline looks like ~90s burst.

Maya: running the quick query: `sum(rate(router_latency_bucket{le="0.5"}[1m]))` -> not helpful, but `p95(router_request_duration, 1m)` shows the blip.

Sanjay: copying grafana: https://grafana.example/graph?panelId=42 (short link)

Leo: any 5xx errors?

Maya: no 5xx increase, error rate flat. Likely KV warmup / cache miss causing tail latency rather than upstream errors.

incident-bot: PD:INCIDENT12345 escalated to secondary (no response from primary in 2m).

Maya: got it. I'm SSH'ing into the router host with high qps to check.

Jess: FYI I just looked at customer-facing traces in honeycomb — sessions show a ~1.5s extra tail on a subset, but no request failures.

Sanjay: looks like a transient cascade: upstream prefills backpressure -> slow kv hits -> increased per-token time. Matches the autoscaler kicking a few nodes.

Maya: mitigations applied: 1) temporarily raised router concurrency cap on node-4, 2) disabled a non-critical background job on the same hosts to free CPU.

Maya: patching the autoscaler config is risky mid-incident; prefer to add a temporary capacity shim.

incident-bot: Alert auto-resolved (metric returned below threshold). PD:INCIDENT12345 status: auto-resolved.

Leo: thanks. Can someone confirm customer impact? any support tickets?

Jess: Checked support queue: nothing correlating. Latency spike was short (~2m window) and below visible threshold for most product surfaces. Marking customer-impact = none.

Maya: agree. No visible errors, small p95 blip for a subset only.

Sanjay: will follow-up with tuning suggestion: increase evaluation window to 3m and require sustained p95 > threshold for alert to fire, and add KV prefill warmup metric to the alert runbook.

Maya: creating follow-up ticket: INC-7892 with summary and graphs. Adding action items: (1) change alert eval window, (2) add jitter to prefill to avoid cascade, (3) run a small canary of autoscaler change.

Jess: leaving note for next oncall: if you see similar, check `kv_prefill_queue_len` and `router_cpu_iowait`, and prefer temporary cap increase over rolling autoscaler changes.

Maya: handing off to next oncall in ~25m, no further action required right now.

Leo: thanks team. Proposal: schedule a short postmortem in #incidents tomorrow to decide on tuning.

Maya: noted. Closing thread once INC-7892 created. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Notification: incident auto-resolved, no escalation required.

incident-bot: (system) Generated tags: auto-resolve, transient, potential-kv-warmup.
